Title: Though the Heavens Fall
Writer: David Reed, Garth Ennis, Darick Robertson
Actors: Karl Urban, Jack Quaid, Antony Starr
Plot: Hughie and Starlight plant a virus at the Church while facing Oh Father. Meanwhile, the team seeks the Legend's aid to locate Golden Geisha for the final V1 dose, leading to a clash with Bombsight, Homelander, and Soldier Boy.
